!
version 17.9
!
hostname rt-y01
!
crypto ikev2 proposal PROP-SAMPLE
 encryption aes-cbc-256
 integrity sha256
 group 14
!
crypto ikev2 policy POL-SAMPLE
 proposal PROP-SAMPLE
!
crypto ikev2 keyring KR-SAMPLE
 peer ix-y02
  address 203.0.113.20
  pre-shared-key local dummy-psk-site-y01
  pre-shared-key remote dummy-psk-site-y02
 !
!
crypto ikev2 profile V2-SAMPLE
 match identity remote fqdn ix-y02.example.com
 identity local fqdn rt-y01.example.com
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local KR-SAMPLE
 lifetime 43200
 dpd 30 5 periodic
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-SAMPLE esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
 mode tunnel
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE
 set transform-set TS-SAMPLE
 set pfs group14
 set security-association lifetime seconds 3600
 set ikev2-profile V2-SAMPLE
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.252
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample lan
 ip address 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.0
!
interface Tunnel1
 description sample vpn
 ip address 192.0.2.209 255.255.255.252
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.20
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.10
ip route 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1
!
end
